articles.summary: ROCKVILLE, Maryland and EDMONTON, Alberta – May 7, 2026 – Aurinia Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ: AUPH) today announced financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and provided an update on recent business progress.
articles.title: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals Reports Financial Results for the Three Months Ended March 31, 2026 and Provides Update on Recent Business Progress
